$comment: Opt-in curated Claude Code permission baseline for repositories that import this template. See docs/permissions.md#claude-code-permission-baseline before adopting it. This repository records mergePolicy: fully_autonomous_merge in .github/idd/config.json, so this baseline (unlike the template's default opt-in copy) allows `gh pr merge` and does not deny `node scripts/idd-merge-execute.mjs` / `node bin/idd-merge-execute.mjs` -- see docs/permissions.md#merge-policy-profiles. `gh api` is deliberately NOT allowlisted here at all -- see the gh-api DELETE-verb trap in docs/permissions.md before adding any `gh api` entry yourself. Personal additions belong in .claude/settings.local.json, which layers on top of this file. Three entries are hardened beyond the upstream template (Codex review, PR #17): `git diff*` split into exact `git diff` plus space-bounded `git diff *` (the wildcard form also prefix-matched `git difftool --extcmd=...`, an arbitrary-command path); `git branch -v*` narrowed to exact `git branch -v` (the wildcard form also matched flag-reordered mutations like `git branch -v -D <branch>`); `git fetch origin*` narrowed to exact `git fetch origin` and `git fetch origin main` (the wildcard form also matched a `+src:dst` refspec that force-overwrites a local branch). A resume/takeover fetch of an arbitrary branch name now falls through to the normal permission prompt instead of auto-approving.
